title: Relocation and Site Transfer: Small Business Electricity Supply Terms and Conditions
content:
**1.** When a business relocates, a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement whose plan permits site transfers may be moved to another commercial site of the same customer for the remainder of its term, keeping its plan, contract rate and contract end date.

**2.** A site transfer is made only on an active agreement, as shown by the agreement record's status.

**3.** The new site must belong to the same customer, must not have another live small business agreement or Beacon Ridge commercial and industrial contract, must meet the small business usage limit, and, when the plan requires the same utility, must be served by the same electric utility as the old site.

**4.** A month-to-month plan is not transferred; the business cancels it and enrolls the new site.

**5.** A relocation that cannot be transferred is not a ground for waiving the early termination fee.

**6.** The following clause is **no longer in force**: "The transfer takes effect on the new site's next scheduled meter read date and one site transfer fee of the plan's site transfer fee is billed with the new site recorded on it." It has been superseded and is not applied.

## Requirements for the new site

| Requirement | Basis |
|---|---|
| Commercial site of the same customer | the site record |
| No other live small business agreement on it | the agreement records for that site |
| No Beacon Ridge commercial and industrial contract on it | the contract records for that site |
| Within the small business usage limit | the site record's annual kWh usage |
| Same electric utility as the old site | the utility serving each site; every plan requires it |

All requirements apply together; a site failing any one of them does not receive the agreement.

## What moves with the agreement

The plan, the contract rate and the contract end date stay as they are; the agreement continues at the new site for the remainder of its term.

## Hypothetical cases

- A café on Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24, active, moves to a new commercial unit of the same business served by the same utility with no live agreement on it: the agreement may move there with its plan, rate and end date.
- A shop on Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable relocates: the plan is not transferred; the business cancels it and enrolls the new site.
- A business on Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 relocates to a site of a different utility: the agreement is not transferred, and the relocation does not waive the early termination fee.

superseded_clauses: The transfer takes effect on the new site's next scheduled meter read date and one site_transfer_fee of site_transfer_fee_usd is billed with premise_id set to the new site.
